title: Support ticket record (dataset row)
description: One row of the synthetic Iraqi-dialect support dataset. `text` is what the customer wrote; `labels` is the gold answer the pipeline must produce; `draft_reply` is the gold first response used for SFT; `meta` is bookkeeping and is never shown to the model. Confidence is NOT a label: at inference it comes from the log-probability of the category token.

text.description: Raw customer message, Iraqi dialect, may contain typos, Arabizi, English.

created_at.description: Needed to resolve relative dates like البارحة / يوم الأحد.

category.description: Primary issue. Topic 06 names the first five; the other four were added for a wallet operator and are confirmed with support agents in week 1.

secondary_category.description: Set only when the ticket contains a second, separate problem (mixed_issue). The pipeline never splits these; it escalates.

priority.description: Starts from the category default (see routing table) and may be raised: money already gone, large amount, repeat complaint, account locked out.

transaction_ref.description: Exactly as written in the text (TX..., receipt number). null if absent. Must be a substring of `text`.

amount_iqd.description: Normalised amount of the disputed transaction in IQD. Balances and limits mentioned in passing are NOT the amount.

amount_text.description: The span in the text the amount was taken from (ربع مليون, ١٠٠ الف, 50 alf). Must be a substring of `text`. This is what the grounding check verifies.

date.description: Resolved transaction date (ISO). Relative words are resolved against created_at.

date_text.description: The span the date came from (البارحة, يوم الاحد, قبل ساعة). Must be a substring of `text`.

flags.description: Things the pipeline must notice. mixed_issue and instruction_in_text always force escalate=true.

escalate.description: Gold decision: true when a person must look before routing (mixed issue, instruction in text, genuinely ambiguous). Low confidence at inference time is added by the pipeline, not labelled here.

escalate_reason.description: Short note the pipeline should produce when escalate=true.

draft_reply.description: Gold first response in polite Iraqi dialect. Acknowledges, repeats the reference/amount it found, says which team is on it, promises nothing it cannot keep. Empty string when escalate=true and no safe reply exists.

split.description: test is locked on day one and never used for prompts, training or the threshold. val is used to pick the threshold.

source.description: human = the 50 tickets written by people, not the generator.

generator.description: Model that wrote this ticket, for disclosure.

reviewed.description: true if a human read this row during the 10% hand-check.
